title: Riri's 30th · dinner
when: Saturday 28 November · guests from 7:30pm, eat around 8:30pm
intro: Timings are rough on purpose: everything except the last hour can slip. No fish or seafood anywhere, and no white wine, for Ria.

dishes.label: Two loaves, next to the birthday cake

shops.title: Butcher
shops.where: Boucherie, or the butcher stalls at Marché d'Auteuil

shops.title: Market
shops.where: Marché d'Auteuil, place Jean Lorrain · Sat 7:00–14:30

shops.title: Apéro board
shops.where: Fromager, charcuterie and bakery (market or nearby)

shops.title: Kit to find
shops.where: Check the kitchen; buy only what's missing

Beef tenderloin.fr: Filet de bœuf, cœur de filet
Beef tenderloin.note: Two centre-cut pieces of ~900 g. Ask them to trim (paré) and tie (ficelé) it.

Prosciutto.fr: Jambon de Parme, tranché très fin

Fresh foie gras.note: Or pâté / mousse de canard: slice, skip the sear

Potatoes.fr: Pommes de terre à chair fondante (Agata, Monalisa)
Potatoes.note: Ask for ones good for purée

Puff pastry.note: French rolls are ~230 g each, so get 4 and patch two together per wellington

Dark chocolate.note: A good one: Valrhona, Michel Cluizel, or a chocolatier

Prepared horseradish.note: Can be hard to find; if not, use more hot mustard

Beef stock.fr: Bouillon de bœuf / fond de veau
Beef stock.note: Liquid, or cubes / powder to make it up

extras.name: Cheeses
extras.note: e.g. Comté 24 mois, Brie de Meaux, a chèvre

extras.name: Baguettes
extras.note: Tradition; buy late so they're fresh

extras.name: Instant-read thermometer
extras.note: Really worth having for the beef

extras.name: Butcher's twine
extras.note: Not needed if the butcher ties it

jobs.text: Season and sear both fillets, coat with horseradish mustard, into the fridge uncovered.
With Duxelles: roll each fillet up in its prosciutto layer, then chill.
Oven to 220 °C. Egg-wash, score and salt, then bake to 43–49 °C at the centre (35–45 min).
Rest 10 min, then carve with the serrated knife. Chives and salt on the cut faces.
Duxelles (double batch) and the foie gras, then chill.
Phyllo, prosciutto and duxelles layers; with Beef, roll the fillets. Roll out the pastry and wrap both. Chill at least 30 min.
Mince the chives, and help Sides.
Slice the shallots and garlic. Reduce the stock and wine, then turn the heat off.
Blanch the beans and chill them in iced water. Dry, then set aside.
Potatoes on. Rice and finish the purée, then keep it warm.
Finish the jus. Toast the almonds and toss the beans.

jobs.when: First, before the oven gets busy
jobs.text: Bake both Tokyo gâteaux at 140 °C, cool and chill. They need 3 hr+ to set.
Lay the table. Apéro board out as guests arrive.
Unmould and slice the gâteaux; candles on the birthday cake.
